"""The next free global reference id.

    COMPUTED, NEVER STORED. A counter table or a `last_ref_id` column would be a
    second home for a fact the reference-id columns already jointly state, which is
    the copy rule 5 forbids. There is no allocator and there should not be one.
    """
    return "REF-%05d" % (ref_id_high_water(conn) + 1)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The refusal record (T-088) — what a writer said no to, kept beside the batch that met it.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# What CLAUDE.md section 7 says `scratchpad/CURRENT` holds. No path separator, so a stem can never leave `scratchpad/`.
SESSION_STEM = re.compile(r"session_\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d[\w.-]*", re.ASCII)

# A flag whose NAME carries one of these WORDS (split on `-` and `_`, any case) has a secret for its value. Whole words, not
# substrings: `--tokens 5`, `--author` and `--pass-id` (real flags) are not secrets. `p` is `-p`.
#: The zero-width characters a base cell may not carry (T-083 repair, migration 156): U+200B, U+200C, U+200D, U+2060,
#: U+FEFF. Python's str.strip() does not remove them, so a cell holding only one reads as filled. Migration 156's CHECKs
#: spell the same five as char(...); scripts/tests/test_db_amend_writers.py T083-12 compares the two.
ZERO_WIDTH = "\u200b\u200c\u200d\u2060\ufeff"

@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def blank_chars() -> frozenset:
    """THE ONE DEFINITION OF A BLANK CHARACTER (T-078 repair): every code point of Unicode category Cc (controls), Cf
    (format: soft hyphen, zero-width and bidi marks, invisible operators), Zs, Zl, Zp (separators), plus the two
    letters that render as nothing, U+2800 BRAILLE PATTERN BLANK and U+3164 HANGUL FILLER. A text made only of these
    says nothing. Migration 160's triggers spell the same set (test T078-40 pins it). Computed once, on first use."""
    import unicodedata
    return frozenset(c for c in map(chr, range(0x110000))
                     if unicodedata.category(c) in ("Cc", "Cf", "Zs", "Zl", "Zp")) | frozenset("\u2800\u3164")


def is_blank(text) -> bool:
    """True when `text` is None or holds only `blank_chars()`."""
    return not text or all(c in blank_chars() for c in text)


def is_session_stem(text) -> bool:
    """The shape of a stored session: `session_` and a name, no `.md` (session_stem) and nothing blank in it. No
    sibling table's CHECK states a shape; this is read from the live stems, every one of which starts `session_`."""
    return isinstance(text, str) and text.startswith("session_") and len(text) > len("session_") \
        and not text.endswith(".md") and not any(c in blank_chars() or c.isspace() for c in text)

_SECRET_WORDS = frozenset("token secret passwd password passphrase pwd credential credentials auth authorization key "
                          "apikey pat bearer cookie p".split())

_NOT_PATH = r"(?<![\w/.:~-])"      # a private path is rewritten only where a path STARTS: never inside a URL or a word
_SCRUBS = (                         # (pattern, replacement), applied in this order to every stored string
    (re.compile(r"(?<![\w/.:~-])/tmp/claude-\d+/-[^/\s'\"]*(?:/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f-]{27})?"), "<scratch>"),
               listed_b and f"extraction {g2}" in (listed_b[0]["targets"] or "") and listed_a
               and f"extraction {g2}" not in (listed_a[0]["targets"] or ""), (listed_b, listed_a))
        due_a = {r["translation_id"] for r in db.translations_due(DUE)}
        record("T078-37", "translations --due-at does not owe a request on a retired figure",
               t_rec in due_b and t_rec not in due_a, (t_rec, sorted(due_b)[-3:], sorted(due_a)[-3:]))
        # amend-extraction --field comparator on a base: refused while a LIVE derived figure uses it, accepted once retired
        b38, d38 = seed(RA, claimed_value="60"), seed(RA, claimed_value="61")
        k38 = seed(RA, claimed_value="121", figure_role="derived", claim_text=None)
        edge(k38, "derived_from", b38, "base")
        edge(k38, "derived_from", d38, "delta")
        newcmp = next(v for v in sorted(dbcore.check_values(ro(), "source_value_extractions", "comparator")) if v != ">=")
        r38a = refusal(db.amend_extraction, b38, "comparator", newcmp, WHY, S)
        retire(k38)
        r38b = refusal(db.amend_extraction, b38, "comparator", newcmp, WHY, S)
        record("T078-38", "amend-extraction --field comparator on a base is refused while a live derived figure uses it and "
               "accepted once that derived figure is retired",
               r38a and "is an input of derived" in r38a and f"[{k38}]" in r38a and r38b is None, (r38a, r38b))
        # migration 160: one blank set, pinned; the frozen columns derived; the holes
        mig160 = (REPO / "scripts" / "migrations" / "160_figure_retirement_shape.sql").read_text()
        trig = re.search(r"CREATE TRIGGER trg_sve_retirement_shape_insert.*?END;", mig160, re.S).group(0)
        in_glob = re.search(r"GLOB '\*\[' \|\| (.*?) \|\| '\]\*'", trig).group(1)
        spelled = {chr(int(n)) for grp in re.findall(r"char\(([0-9,]+)\)", in_glob) for n in grp.split(",")}
        in_trim = re.search(r"trim\(NEW\.retirement_reason, (.*?)\) = ''", trig).group(1)
        record("T078-40", "migration 160 spells dbcore.blank_chars() (less U+0000) in both its session and its reason test",
               spelled == set(dbcore.blank_chars()) - {"\x00"} and in_trim == in_glob, len(spelled))
        frozen = re.search(r"trg_sve_retired_row_frozen\s+BEFORE UPDATE OF (.*?) ON source_value_extractions", mig160,
                           re.S).group(1)
        want = [r[1] for r in q("PRAGMA table_info(source_value_extractions)")
                if r[1] not in ("retired_at", "retired_by_session", "retirement_reason", "updated_at", "updated_by_session")]
        record("T078-41", "the frozen-row trigger names every column of the table but the three retirement columns and the "
               "updated_* stamps (a later column fails this case until a migration adds it)",
               [x.strip() for x in frozen.split(",")] == want, (frozen[:80], len(want)))
        live3 = seed(RA, claimed_value="70")
        ret3 = seed(RA, claimed_value="71")
        retire(ret3)
        U3 = ("UPDATE source_value_extractions SET retired_at=?, retired_by_session=?, retirement_reason=? "
-- 160_figure_retirement_shape.sql
-- SCHEMA migration (T-078, second repair after the adversarial pass). No data rows. Compensating: 158 and 159 are not
-- edited.
--
-- 1. ONE DEFINITION OF BLANK. 159's triggers trimmed migration 154's whitespace set and dbcore.ZERO_WIDTH, so a reason
--    of U+180E, U+00AD, U+2800, U+3164, U+200E or U+2063 passed, and U+001F passed the trigger while the verb refused
--    it. The set is now dbcore.blank_chars(): Unicode categories Cc, Cf, Zs, Zl, Zp and U+2800, U+3164, spelled below
--    without U+0000 (char(0) ends a string in SQLite's text functions; a NUL cannot be typed into a reason through
--    the CLI). Test T078-40 pins the spelling to the definition. db.py retire-extraction reads the same definition
--    (dbcore.is_blank). dbcore.require_reason is not tightened: it would move defer-reading's refusal ground (T079-30).
-- 2. RETIRED_AT is text, stamped as dbcore.now() stamps it, a real calendar minute (datetime() round-trips it, so
--    '9999-99-99 99:99' and '2026-02-30 00:00' are refused), not in the future, and not before the row's own
--    created_at where that is a stamp (so '1900-01-01 00:00' is refused on every live row).
-- 3. RETIRED_BY_SESSION is a session stem: 'session_' and a name, no '.md' (dbcore.session_stem), nothing blank in it
--    (dbcore.is_session_stem). No sibling table's CHECK states a session shape; every live stem starts 'session_'.
-- 4. A RETIRED ROW IS FROZEN: once retired_at is set, an UPDATE of any other column but the updated_* stamps is
--    refused (159's trigger already refuses the three retirement columns). The column list is every column of the
--    table at this migration less those five, read from PRAGMA table_info; test T078-41 fails when a later column is
--    not in it.
-- Not closable, recorded again: INSERT OR REPLACE of the same extraction_id (no trigger fires without
-- recursive_triggers). A born-retired INSERT stays allowed when well formed (emit_batch_sql captures a figure added
-- and retired in one batch as one INSERT).

    """The faithful replay order, as a flat list of steps.

    Returns [("schema", version, path), ("data", ts, migration_id, path), ...].

    THE DEFAULT is what it has always been: every schema migration, then every
    data migration. That is right almost always, because schema precedes the
    data it shapes.

    IT IS WRONG WHENEVER A SCHEMA MIGRATION RENAMES OR DROPS SOMETHING THAT
    COMMITTED DATA MIGRATIONS STILL NAME. Data migrations are immutable, so they
    keep writing to the old name forever; a schema-phase rename runs first and
    they die on replay. Migration 025 hit this from the other side and had to
    withdraw a data migration to escape it. The 055 rename hit it from this side
    across 19 data migrations spanning two months, where withdrawal is not
    available.
def rebuild_from_migrations(target_db_path: str, dry_run: bool = False):
    """Build a DB from scratch by applying every migration in order. Used by CI."""
    target = Path(target_db_path)
    if target.exists() and not dry_run:
        target.unlink()
    print(f"Rebuilding {target} from migration history...")
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(target), isolation_level=None)

def _kind_refusal(conn, label, verb, quantity_kind, source_url, source_page, source_line, source_clause, ref_id,
                  quote=None):
    """The refusals on a parameter's quantity kind and its warrant, one home for add-parameter and set-parameter-kind
    (T-020, T-083): the kind is a row of `base_quantity_kinds` (the refusal names every kind and the verb that adds
    one); the warrant says where a source states a value of the quantity and quotes it, in the row's own cells (OD-71:
    a URL and a page or a clause, checked as add-alias checks a locator, and the words, which must hold a digit, as
    T-020 required of the observation it pointed at). No cell may carry a zero-width character (dbcore.ZERO_WIDTH),
    as migration 156's CHECKs hold. `ref_id` is provenance only: kept, its shape checked, never looked up.
    Returns the cells to write."""
    kinds = [r[0] for r in conn.execute("SELECT kind_id FROM base_quantity_kinds ORDER BY kind_id")]
    quantity_kind = str(quantity_kind or "").strip()
    if quantity_kind not in kinds:
        raise Refusal(
            f"{label}: --quantity-kind {quantity_kind or '(none)'!r} is not a "
            f"kind of base_quantity_kinds. A parameter is a quantity: say which kind. The kinds are "
            f"{kinds}; a kind that is missing is added by data: db.py add-quantity-kind --kind-id ... "
            f"--definition ... --approval-ref '<dated ledger heading>' --session ... Nothing was written.\n"
            f"Two cases are two parameters only when they cannot be placed on one scale or their "
            f"accessibility directions differ.")
    blank = " \t\n\r" + dbcore.ZERO_WIDTH
    stripped = [v.strip().strip(blank) if isinstance(v, str) else v for v in (source_url, source_page, source_clause, quote)]
    if not stripped[0] or not (stripped[1] or stripped[2]) or not stripped[3]:
        raise Refusal(
            f"{label}: the kind {quantity_kind!r} is a judgment and needs its warrant, held on the parameter's own "
            f"row (OD-71): where a source states a value of this quantity, and its words. Give --quantity-kind-quote "
            f"(the words, verbatim), --quantity-kind-source-url and --quantity-kind-source-page or "
            f"--quantity-kind-source-clause (--quantity-kind-source-line is optional; --quantity-kind-ref-id, the "
            f"source's ref_id, is provenance only). Nothing was written.")
    for flag, v in (("--quantity-kind-source-url", source_url), ("--quantity-kind-source-page", source_page),
                    ("--quantity-kind-source-clause", source_clause), ("--quantity-kind-ref-id", ref_id)):
        if isinstance(v, str) and any(ch in dbcore.ZERO_WIDTH for ch in v):
            raise Refusal(f"{verb}: {flag} {v!r} carries a zero-width character; retype it without one. "
                          f"Nothing was written.")
    url, page, clause = _check_base_locator(verb, [], source_url, source_page, source_line, source_clause,
                                            prefix="quantity-kind-")
    quote = quote.strip()
    if not any(ch.isdigit() for ch in quote):
        raise Refusal(
            f"{label}: --quantity-kind-quote {quote!r} holds no digit; a passage stating no value cannot show what "
            f"the quantity is measured in. Quote the source's words where it states a value. Nothing was written.")
    ref_id = (ref_id.strip() or None) if isinstance(ref_id, str) else ref_id
    return {"quantity_kind": quantity_kind, "quantity_kind_source_url": url, "quantity_kind_source_page": page,
            "quantity_kind_source_line": source_line, "quantity_kind_source_clause": clause,
            "quantity_kind_ref_id": ref_id, "quantity_kind_quote": quote}


def set_parameter_kind(parameter_id: int, quantity_kind: str, session: str, quantity_kind_source_url: str = None,
                       quantity_kind_source_page: str = None, quantity_kind_source_line: int = None,
                       quantity_kind_source_clause: str = None, quantity_kind_ref_id: str = None,
                       quantity_kind_quote: str = None, dry_run: bool = False):
    """Set the quantity kind and its warrant on a parameter that already exists (T-083; T-109 is its reader).

    Refuses, in this order: an unknown parameter; one that is not active (a merge names its survivor); the shared
    refusals of `_kind_refusal`; a parameter whose kind is already set (WRITE-ONCE: a kind that changed under a
    parameter would change what every stored figure of it means; no overwrite path is built); a LIVE determination
    or an OPEN gate on it (`_refuse_live_work`: a determination computed before the parameter had a kind would
    silently gain one). Then one UPDATE of the kind and warrant cells with the updated_* stamp."""
    with connect(dry_run) as conn:
        row = _parameter_row(conn, parameter_id, "set-parameter-kind")
